name: Per-tile Sorting and Per-pixel Resorting
aliases: StopThePop's per-tile sorting and per-pixel resorting
definition: A sorting strategy to address the sensitivity of alpha-blending order in surface-based representations (2DGS, QGS) where Gaussian distribution is concentrated on the surface. It uses per-tile sorting for global ordering and per-pixel resorting for local ordering to remove streak-like and blocky artifacts.
